山巅云散，天光破晓。

长白山主峰绝顶的三重祭坛之上，硝烟散尽，寒风渐柔。

笼罩山巅数日不散的黑紫色邪煞阴气，随着鬼将湮灭、三大咒师伏诛、献祭大阵彻底崩毁，正以肉眼可见的速度缓缓褪去。厚重阴霾拨开，暖融融的晨光穿透云层，倾洒在黑石祭台、残破石阶与荒芜坛场之上，驱散阴冷，抚平戾气。

地底龙脉不再震颤躁动，原本被强行抽取、侵染的龙气缓缓回流，沿着长白山山脉地脉脉络重新归于平稳温润。周遭山林间滞涩压抑的气场一扫而空，鸟兽渐渐恢复啼鸣，草木重新焕发生机，被邪煞禁锢多年的关外群山，终于挣脱阴霾，重归安宁。

众人伫立主祭台之上，衣衫染着尘土、煞气与淡淡血痕，气息皆有损耗，神色却沉稳平静。

一场从西风荒村绵延至白山云巅的正邪死战，历经阴阵、蛊瘴、忍杀、式神、古观、崖口、三重祭坛层层血战，终以华夏修士完胜、东瀛三派全军覆没落下帷幕。

甲贺忍者精锐死士殆尽，九菊一派顶尖养蛊师全员陨落，阴阳寮坐镇山巅的三名大咒师、老牌大咒师渡边苍玄尽数伏诛，驯养的式神军团、万蛊蛊王、百年鬼将无一幸存。

盘踞长白山数十年，暗中布局觊觎东北龙脉、布设献祭大阵、残害关外百姓、侵蚀山河地脉的域外邪祟势力，今日被彻底连根拔起，覆灭殆尽。

“总算……结束了。”李二牛长长吐出一口浊气，仙家灵光缓缓退敛体内，望着重归清朗的山巅天际，感慨万千，“从进山到现在，一路步步杀机，层层堵截，这帮东瀛邪祟把长白山经营得跟铁桶一样，愣是被咱们一路横推，连根给刨了。”

王欣欣收起手中暗器囊，轻轻擦拭指尖残留的煞气灰迹，目光扫过遍地邪祟尸骸与残破咒纹：“外围防线、中转祭台、山巅三重祭坛，每一处都布下杀局、埋伏死手，若是换做普通修士队伍，早就被困死在半路，根本走不到主坛。”

茉沫拢了拢肩头凌乱衣衫，望着恢复平静的蛊池与鬼柱残骸：“九菊养蛊、甲贺忍术、阴阳咒道，三方联手互补，阴阵、蛊瘴、幻术、暗杀、献祭样样齐全，野心大到敢直接染指华夏龙脉，属实狂妄至极。”

范梦雪收敛周身流转的雷光，雷道灵气缓缓归于丹田。连续催动神霄雷法，硬撼鬼将、抗衡咒阵，她消耗极大，面色带着一丝苍白，却眼神清亮：“邪术再诡、阵法再密、人手再多，终究是旁门左道，逆天道、犯山河，注定难成气候。正统道脉、雷道、蛊道、仙家术法，本就克制这些阴邪外道。”

钱丹静坐一旁，闭目调息，袖中白蛊轻轻蛰伏。强破万蛊绝阵、催动本命蛊母对战蛊王，对她心神与灵气损耗极重，此刻吞服固元丹药，慢慢梳理紊乱的蛊脉气息，净化体内沾染的蛊毒余韵。

杨瑞走到祭台边缘，蹲下身指尖抚过已经黯淡风化的血色献祭纹路，眉头微蹙：“献祭大阵虽已被毁，咒师尽数伏诛，但这些地底咒纹、祭台石基、蛊池地气，还残留着大量邪煞余韵与献祭怨气。若是不彻底清算净化，再过数年，阴煞重新汇聚，难保不会再有邪人借机重开祭坛、再布煞局。”

林佳点头认同，打开随身煞气监测平板，屏幕上数值已然大幅回落，但依旧有零星黑点散落在祭坛各处、山巅岩缝、地底裂隙之中：“仪器检测到多处残留煞气节点、怨气聚点、地底阴脉余痕。战后善后不能马虎，必须逐一清理、净化、封印，抹去所有邪阵根基，杜绝后患。”

胡九郎迎风立在祭台最高处，黑衣衣摆随风轻扬，目光俯瞰连绵关外群山，天眼缓缓扫遍整座山巅台地、三重祭坛每一处角落、山体岩缝与地底脉络。

The clouds dispersed on the mountain top and dawn broke.

On the triple altar at the top of the main peak of Changbai Mountain, the smoke has cleared and the cold wind is gradually softening.

The black and purple evil spirit that had been covering the top of the mountain for several days was slowly fading away at a speed visible to the naked eye as the ghost generals were annihilated, the three major spell masters were killed, and the sacrifice formation completely collapsed.The heavy haze parted, and the warm morning light penetrated the clouds and poured on the black stone altar, broken stone steps and deserted altar, dispelling the coldness and calming the hostility.

The underground dragon veins no longer trembled and restless, and the dragon energy that had been forcibly extracted and infected slowly returned, returning to stability and warmth along the veins of the Changbai Mountains.The stagnant and oppressive aura in the surrounding mountains and forests was swept away, the birds and animals gradually resumed their chirping, and the vegetation regained its vitality. The mountains outside the pass, which had been imprisoned by evil spirits for many years, finally broke free from the haze and returned to peace.

Everyone stood on the main altar, their clothes stained with dust, evil spirits and faint traces of blood. Their breaths were all worn out, but their expressions were calm and calm.

A life-and-death battle between good and evil that stretched from Xifeng Huang Village to the top of Baishan Mountain, and went through layers of bloody battles including Yin Formation, Gu Miasma, Ninja Killing, Shishen, Ancient Temple, Yakou, and Triple Altar, finally ended with the complete victory of the Chinese monks and the complete annihilation of the three Japanese sects.

All the elite ninja dead in Koga were wiped out, all the top Gu masters of the Jiuju sect died, the three great spell masters of the Yin Yang Lao who were sitting on the top of the mountain, and the veteran great spell master Watanabe Sogen were all killed. None of the domesticated shikigami army, the ten thousand Gu kings, and the hundred-year-old ghost generals survived.

The evil forces from outside the territory that have been entrenched in the Changbai Mountains for decades, secretly planning to covet the Northeast Dragon Vein, setting up large sacrificial arrays, killing the people outside the pass, and eroding the mountains and rivers, have been completely uprooted and wiped out today.

"Finally... it's over." Li Erniu exhaled a long breath of turbid air, and the aura of the immortal family slowly retreated from his body. He looked at the clear sky on the mountain top again and was filled with emotion. "From the time we entered the mountain to now, we have been killing every step of the way and intercepting them layer by layer. These Japanese evil spirits have managed Changbai Mountain like an iron barrel. We pushed them all the way and dug them up to the root."

Wang Xinxin put away the concealed weapon pouch in her hand and gently wiped the residual evil aura on her fingertips. She glanced at the evil corpses and broken curse patterns everywhere: "The outer defense line, the transit altar, and the three-level altar on the mountain are all set up to kill and ambushes. If it were an ordinary team of monks, they would have been trapped and died in the middle of the road, unable to reach the main altar."

Momo gathered her messy clothes on her shoulders and looked at the calm Gu Pond and the remains of the ghost pillar: "Nine chrysanthemum cultivating Gu, Koga Ninjutsu, and Yin and Yang curses, the three parties work together to complement each other. Yin formation, Gu miasma, illusions, assassinations, and sacrifices are all complete. He is so ambitious that he dares to directly interfere with the Chinese dragon vein. It is really arrogant."

Fan Mengxue restrained the thunder light circulating around her body, and the thunder aura slowly returned to her dantian.Continuously activating Shenxiao's thunder method to shake the ghost generals and counter the spell formation, she consumed a lot. Her face was a little pale, but her eyes were clear: "No matter how cunning the evil spells are, no matter how dense the formations are, and no matter how many people there are, they are all hereditary practices that go against the heavens and violate the mountains and rivers. They are destined to be difficult to achieve. The orthodox Dao, Thunder Dao, Gu Dao, and Immortal magic are all designed to restrain these evil heretics."

Qian Dan sat quietly aside, closed his eyes and adjusted his breath, while the white poison in his sleeve was dormant.Breaking through the formation of ten thousand poisonous poisons and activating the natural poisonous poisonous mother to fight against the poisonous poisonous king had a great impact on her mind and spiritual energy. At this moment, she swallowed the Gu Yuan elixir, slowly sorted out the chaotic poisonous poisonous atmosphere, and purified the aftertaste of the poisonous poison in her body.

Yang Rui walked to the edge of the altar, squatted down and touched the faded and weathered bloody sacrifice lines with his fingertips, frowning slightly: "Although the sacrifice array has been destroyed and all the spell masters have been killed, these underground curse lines and the altar stone foundation, there is still a lot of residual evil spirit and sacrificial resentment in the Gu Pond.If it is not completely cleaned up and purified, in a few years, the evil spirits will gather again, and there is no guarantee that evil people will not take the opportunity to reopen the altar and create another evil plot."

Lin Jia nodded in agreement and turned on the portable evil energy monitoring tablet. The values on the screen had dropped significantly, but there were still sporadic black spots scattered around the altar, in the rock cracks on the mountain top, and in the underground fissures: "The instrument detected many residual evil energy nodes, resentment gathering points, and traces of underground Yin veins. The aftermath of the war cannot be careless. It must be cleaned, purified, and sealed one by one to erase all the foundations of the evil formation to prevent future troubles."

Hu Jiulang stood at the highest point of the altar facing the wind, with the hem of his black clothes fluttering in the wind. He looked down at the mountains outside the pass, and his eyes slowly scanned the entire mountaintop platform, every corner of the triple altar, the cracks in the mountains and the underground veins.
